title: BenchX target provider request
description: What the workbench writes to a target provider's stdin (docs/design/system-decomposition.md §3.4). One request is one target; a comparison is two independent requests. The provider answers with a target description on stdout, or exits nonzero with its message on stderr.
$comment: prepare may build, incrementally and repeatably, and must finish before any work order exists. describe never builds or changes anything: it reports a target that already exists, and exits nonzero when there is none. configuration is a project-defined name that benchx treats as opaque.

source_ref.description: What to provide a target for: a revision, the token WORKSPACE for the current checkout, or a path. Interpreted by the provider.

configuration.description: Project-defined configuration name, such as hardened or plain. Opaque to benchx; absent or null means the provider's default.
